body:
## Why

**No card owns this, and everything downstream assumes it is done.** A6 (#294) composed the two tiers and
said so plainly in its result: the verbs were deliberately out of scope. C1 (#303) tried to move the test
assertion sites onto a store double and found, file by file, that **zero of the 121 sites can move**,
because `src/cli.js`, `src/dispatch.js`, `src/lifecycle.js`, `src/context.js`, `src/stats.js` and
`src/hook.js` all still import the GitHub bodies through the `src/tasks.js`/`src/lock.js` re-export shims —
nothing installed at the seam is on their path. C2 (#304) opens by *deleting* `src/store/github.js` and
those shims, which presumes every caller already routes through `openStore`.

So the plan (`docs/local-first.md` §10) has A6 land the store, C1 test against it and C2 delete the old
one, with nothing in between that moves the callers. Two workers each guessed a different owner ("track
C's paths", "routing the verbs is track B") because there is no owner. This card is that step.

It is also what unblocks root A: #288's verification is a scratch repo running `hkb init --store local`
then create → claim → finish → serve end to end, which cannot pass while the verbs read GitHub. And it is
what lets `hkb init` default back to `local` — `resolveStore` and its test both carry a "flip this back
when the verbs are routed" note pointing here.

## What

Move every board read and write off `src/tasks.js`/`src/lock.js` and onto `openStore(ctx)`. **No deletion
and no behaviour change** — the shims stay until #304, the GitHub driver stays the default, and a board on
`"store": "github"` must behave exactly as it does today.

1. `src/cli.js`, `src/lifecycle.js`, `src/dispatch.js`, `src/context.js`, `src/stats.js`, `src/hook.js`:
   every call that reaches board state goes through `openStore(ctx)`. Where a caller needs a shape the
   interface does not have, add it to the interface (`src/store/index.js`) and to **both** drivers with a
   scenario in `test/store.test.js` — never a fresh call into `gh.js`, per CLAUDE.md.
2. Where the two drivers disagree on a shape, the contract in §6.4 wins and the driver changes. #315's
   review already found this class once: the index tier had `blocked_by: number[]` and `needs_human` where
   the contract says `blockedBy[{number,state}]` and `needsHuman`, and a forwarding driver got wrong rows
   with no error. Expect more of it here; a shape mismatch must fail loudly, not silently.
3. `setStore()` and `test/fake-store.js` (PR #324, merged ahead of this card) are the injection point and
   the double. As call sites move, they become testable against the double — but **do not** rewrite the 121
   assertion sites here; that is #303's whole job and this card's `paths` exclude `test/` except for what
   the moves force.
4. When it is done, flip `hkb init`'s default back to `local`: `resolveStore` (`src/init.js`), its doc
   block, the test at `test/init.test.js`, and the README's "How it works" preamble and "Where this is,
   right now" note all say where and why.

## Done when

- [ ] `grep -rn "from './tasks.js'\|from './lock.js'" src` returns nothing outside `src/store/`.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` green with **no test rewritten to accommodate the move** — a test that has
      to change is a behaviour change and needs saying on the card.
- [ ] A scratch repo on `--store local` runs `hkb create` → `hkb list` → `hkb claim` → `hkb finish`, with
      the exact commands in the result. This is the check root A is waiting for.
- [ ] The same walk-through on a `--store github` board is unchanged.
- [ ] `hkb init` defaults to `local` again, and the four "flip this back" notes are gone.
- [ ] The wiki page each change touches is updated (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs`).

## Contract

Do not delete the GitHub driver or the shims (#304). Do not migrate this repository's own board. Keep
`src/gh.js` as the only place that shells out to `gh`. Pure logic in `src/model.js` with a test. Errors
name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` §6.4 (the interface) and §7, `docs/wiki/architecture/store-seam.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Finish with one draft PR and exactly one
terminal verb.
title: Route the verbs through openStore: move cli/lifecycle/dispatch/context/stats/hook off the tasks.js and lock.js shims
